modules.name: BCICore
modules.role: pure-Swift models, protocols, ring buffer, intent FSM, and the dialectic engine (Sources/BCICore/Dialectic/). No third-party deps.

modules.name: BCIEEG
modules.role: EEG streams: BrainFlow facade + synthetic + playback; supervisor retry/backoff -> synthetic fallback.

modules.name: BCIClassifier
modules.role: Core ML intent classifier (ANE-preferred) + mock; CoreMLSentenceEmbedder (BGE-small-en-v1.5).

modules.name: BCILLM
modules.role: ISOLATED MLX adapter: next-word predictor, tokenizer, spectral-state estimator. The ONLY MLX-importing target.

modules.name: BCICloudBridge
modules.role: the ONE network-egress module: ClaudeCLIGenerator (claude -p, Sonnet 5, no API key). Must never be a dependency of any BCI* target.

modules.name: NeuralComposeApp
modules.role: SwiftUI app; AppContainer composition root; AppViewModel.

modules.name: WorldModelDemo
modules.role: synthetic-task JEPA+MPC research demo, decoupled from the EEG pipeline.

invariants: MLX isolation: import MLX only in BCILLM — one runtime copy in the linked binary.
No network at runtime EXCEPT BCICloudBridge/ClaudeCLIGenerator, used only by the opt-in Stage-5 hypnagogic loop (decision_registry entry 8).
Stub-by-default: missing model -> mock, missing weights -> stub, bridge stub -> synthetic EEG; the privacy banner reflects the active path.
App talks to subsystems through BCICore protocols only.
Strict concurrency + ExistentialAny enabled on every target.
SpectralState is a heuristic gloss/bias, never a cognitive decode — 4-ch Muse cannot support mental-state claims.
Track A (jaw/blink/rest carousel + dwell-select) is the only supported typing path; Track B (imagined speech) is experimental and pre-registration-gated.

dialectic_engine.per_turn: two DialecticalRoles generate -> embed -> score(coherence/resonance/novelty) -> compete (tension-sharpened softmax, injected RNG) -> spoke | silent | synthesized; two clocks: SpectralGloss (fast EMA) biases DialecticalField (slow inertia), combined only inside compete.
dialectic_engine.registers: WAKING role set (DialecticalRole.wakingRoles) + ClaudeCLIGenerator.wakingDialecticalSystemPrompt for the three current (waking) profiles; the sleep-mirror roles + hypnagogicSystemPrompt are reserved for the future wind-down / hypnagogic / dream rungs.
